title: Therapeutic exosomes in cancer: efficacy and safety perspectives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30633-30648
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00373G, Review Article
Open Access

Rajib Dhar, Ling Shing Wong, Vetriselvan Subramaniyan
Therapeutic exosomes are cutting-edge, cell-free, promising tools for cancer treatment due to their biocompatibility, targeting ability, and cargo delivery potential. This review discusses current evidence on their efficacy, safety, challenges, and clinical prospects.
